mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (category_id, brand_id, shop_id, name, subtitle, main_image, images, detail, status, sort_order) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{brandId}, #{shopId}, #{name}, #{subtitle}, #{mainImage}, #{images}, #{detail}, #{status}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update:
UPDATE product
category_id = #{categoryId}, brand_id = #{brandId}, name = #{name}, subtitle = #{subtitle}, main_image = #{mainImage}, images = #{images}, detail = #{detail}, status = #{status}, sort_order = #{sortOrder},
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE product SET sales_count = sales_count + #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM product WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
